dialogs.text: Halt, friend.
I can tell from the confidence in your posture and the flight in your footsteps that we three are kindred spirits, practitioners of the martial arts...
What do you want?
Hey! Show him a little more respect when you're talking to him, got it!?
Please, there's no need... it was actually me who started the conversation with them...
Hmph! Well, just as long as they aren't another good-for-nothing bandwagoning adepti-seeker trying to steal our place!
Yes, great, thank you for your concern... I think we'll be fine... Now, why don't you take a well-earned rest while I have a word with our new friend?
But, but surely there's nothing you would say to them that you couldn't say in front of me?
I'd only bore you, it's really nothing you'd be interested in...
Hmph, okay, I get the hint, you wanna talk about the Guhua Clan, again... Fine. If you don't want me to listen, I will leave you well alone.
My friend, over here if you will join me. Then we may talk in depth.
You two have finished speaking, then? Don't look at me like that. If he doesn't want me to listen, I don't listen.
In any case, I'm sure he was harping on about Guhua again. Ugh, in all the time that I've known him, he's never cared for anything else but Guhua...
And that's despite everything I do to try and...
Never mind, what difference is telling you going to make? What're you still doing here anyway? Aren't you supposed to be helping him with something? Go on, on your way!
Right, here will do nicely...
What's this all about?
*sigh* It's about her... Little Que'er, my junior. We've always been inseparable in our martial arts training, like form and shadow. Her skills are in no way inferior to mine.

We came here seeking the guidance of the adepti, but the journey has been an arduous one, and my companion like a box full of chatter that knows no end... A few days prior she fell ill from the cold, and is now afflicted with soreness of the throat.

I see you are one of great strength, and so I humbly beseech you to please venture forth to the top of this cliff, where you should please find me three Qingxin flowers, with which to infuse in hot water and bring some small relief to Que'er's aching throat.
Sure.
Friend, you have my thanks. Que'er is a vivacious soul, and I daren't leave her alone while I go in search of medicine.
But why are you doing this behind her back?
I know you might find this silly. Que'er has a feisty spirit and refuses to accept that she might be at a disadvantage compared to those around her, whatever the circumstances.
Were I to raise the notion of picking medicine for her benefit while she was in earshot, she would reject the proposal without a second thought. Hence, I must act without her knowledge.
Furthermore, I daren't leave her alone here while I go off in search of medicine. That is why I must ask for your assistance.
You two have finished speaking, then? Don't look at me like that. If he doesn't want me to listen, I don't listen.
In any case, I'm sure he was harping on about Guhua again. Ugh, in all the time that I've known him, he's never cared for anything else but Guhua...
And that's despite everything I do to try and...
Never mind, what difference is telling you going to make? What're you still doing here anyway? Aren't you supposed to be helping him with something? Go on, on your way!

dialogs.text: Que'er and I have trained together in the martial arts since childhood. She is like a sister to me.
And yet somehow, the older she becomes, the more she perplexes me.
Things were much simpler when we were children...

flow.stepDescription: Give the Qingxin flowers to Sun Yu

dialogs.text: You have returned! Regarding the matter which I entrusted to your care...
I've picked the flowers.
These shall be plenty. Friend, you have my thanks, please accept this small gift in return...
Huh? What're all these Qingxin flowers for? Oh no, have you got a headache again?
Yes, they're for his headache.
But I would happily have gone to pick medicine for you... Why did you need to get a passer-by to do it instead?
Also, we know nothing about them or their background, what if—
...Enough, Que'er. They helped us, did they not? We have no quarrel with them.
Thank you once more. Please take these.
Yep, take 'em and be on your merry way, don't keep him out in the cold when he's got a headache!
Quickly, let's get you out of the wind! I'll make some sweet tea for you...
Actually, they're for your throat.
Ahem! My good friend, I daresay—
...Are you saying I'm weak? Oh, so you feel the tiniest gust of wind and just assume I have a sore throat!?
Well, luckily the Qingxin flowers won't go to waste — because they can help with his headache.
Que'er, listen...
Come on, let's get you out of the wind and somewhere you can put your feet up! I'll make some sweet tea for you.
As for you... Take these, and get lost.
